recommended_approach: Mantaflow GAS Domain + small mesh Flow emitter centered in the ember/log contact area, with Fire enabled, Noise enabled, low smoke, medium vorticity/reaction speed, and quick smoke dissolve; shade the volume with Principled Volume, and treat sparks as a separate lightweight pass if needed.

key_parameters.surface_emission: resolution-dependent; measured in voxels from the mesh surface
key_parameters.empty_space: use to optimize rendering/OpenVDB cache size after framing is locked

warnings: Flow objects must be contained within the Domain bounding box to affect the simulation.
When fire emission is used, the Domain auto-creates some smoke; keep smoke-driving settings low for a clean-burning campfire.
Surface Emission is resolution-dependent, so changing domain resolution changes the effective emission thickness.
empty_space can improve render/cache efficiency, especially with OpenVDB, but too aggressive a threshold may trim useful low-density volume.
delete_in_obstacle removes fluid volume intersecting obstacles; be careful if logs/stones are used as effectors near the flame source.
API grounding was weaker than manual grounding in the search results; fluid-setting scripting should be verified against Blender 5.0 RNA at implementation time.
alternative_approaches: Shader-only faux campfire using a shaped volume with Principled Volume instead of a baked fluid sim.
Hybrid setup: Mantaflow only for the core flame/smoke, with sparks handled in a separate non-fluid pass/system.
